rows.clue_en: Which Estonian chess grandmaster was nicknamed the “Crown Prince of Chess”?
rows.clue_et: Millist Eesti male suurmeistrit hüüti „male kroonprintsiks“?
rows.explanation_en: Keres represented Estonia at chess Olympiads and is commemorated on Estonia’s two-euro coin issued for his centenary.
rows.explanation_et: Keres esindas Eestit maleolümpiatel ning tema sajandat sünniaastapäeva tähistati Eesti kaheeurose mälestusmündiga.

rows.clue_en: Players slide small discs toward corner pockets in which Baltic tabletop game also played in Estonia?
rows.clue_et: Millises ka Eestis mängitavas Balti lauamängus lükatakse väikesi kettaid nurgataskutesse?
rows.explanation_en: Players propel small discs with cues toward four corner pockets while trying to clear their own colour first.
rows.explanation_et: Mängijad löövad kiidega väikseid kettaid nelja nurgatasku poole ning püüavad oma värvi kettad esimesena laualt eemaldada.

rows.clue_en: Which traditional Estonian throwing game asks players to topple wooden targets arranged inside two marked boxes?
rows.clue_et: Millises traditsioonilises Eesti viskemängus püütakse kahte märgitud kasti paigutatud puidust sihtmärke ümber lüüa?
rows.explanation_en: Descriptions preserved in the Estonian Folklore Archives show that layouts and local rules varied between communities.
rows.explanation_et: Eesti Rahvaluule Arhiivis talletatud kirjeldused näitavad, et sihtmärkide paigutus ja kohalikud reeglid erinesid paiguti.

rows.clue_en: Which traditional Estonian card game for four players uses a 36-card pack and gives the game to the side that takes five tricks?
rows.clue_et: Millises traditsioonilises Eesti nelja mängija kaardimängus kasutatakse 36 kaarti ning võidab pool, kes saab viis tihi?
rows.explanation_en: Partners sit opposite one another, and the compact 36-card pack removes ranks below six.
rows.explanation_et: Partnerid istuvad vastamisi ning 36-kaardilisest pakist puuduvad kuuet madalamad kaardid.

primarySupport.observation: Fresh direct web read of this IFF story reports Sparta as 2023 Estonian champions in both the womens and mens categories. The mens team beat Jogeva SK Tahe/Olivia in the fifth final match. It directly supports organised national floorball competitions in Estonia.

primarySupport.role: equipment and play supplementary primary support
primarySupport.observation: Explains teams, sticks and shoes, lighter carbon-fiber stick shafts, and a rink made from connected boards; the clue does not require skates or ice.
IFF's learning material describes a hollow plastic ball with 26 holes.

licensing.copyrightObservation: IFF's current site pages display copyright 2026 International Floorball Federation (IFF). The official archive page and linked privacy policy do not display an open-content reuse licence.
licensing.permissionConclusion: No Creative Commons, public-domain or other adaptation grant was located. Keep the restrictive existing label; use the URL as factual citation only. The privacy policy covers data processing and is not a content licence.
licensing.limitations: The phrase all-rights-reserved is a conservative existing bank label, not a newly discovered explicit licence text. No page text or media is proposed for copying.

rows.clue_et: See teatri- või kinoseanss toimub õhtuse aja asemel pärastlõunal.
rows.explanation_en: A matinee is a theatrical performance or film screening held during the daytime, especially in the afternoon.
rows.explanation_et: Päevane etendus ehk matinee on teatrietendus või kinoseanss, mis toimub päeval, eriti pärastlõunal.

rows.clue_en: This purchase saves a complete film or episode file to a device for later offline playback.
rows.clue_et: Selle ostuga salvestatakse terve filmi või osa fail seadmesse, et seda hiljem võrguühenduseta vaadata.
rows.explanation_en: A digital movie purchase can be downloaded as a complete file to a device for later offline viewing rather than streamed only while connected.
rows.explanation_et: Digitaalselt ostetud filmi saab laadida tervikliku failina seadmesse, et vaadata seda hiljem võrguühenduseta, mitte üksnes ühenduse ajal voogedastada.
rows.source_title: Redownload TV shows and movies that you purchased — Apple Support

rows.clue_en: Which Austrian-born filmmaker directed the 1927 silent science-fiction epic Metropolis?
rows.clue_et: Milline Austrias sündinud filmitegija lavastas 1927. aasta tumm-ulmefilmi „Metropolis“?
rows.explanation_en: Fritz Lang directed Metropolis, released in 1927.
rows.explanation_et: Fritz Lang lavastas 1927. aastal linastunud filmi „Metropolis“.

rows.clue_en: Which French director made the 1967 crime film Le samouraï, starring Alain Delon as Jef Costello?
rows.clue_et: Milline Prantsuse režissöör lavastas 1967. aasta krimifilmi „Le samouraï“, milles Alain Delon mängib Jef Costellot?
